description: Strict verify_bundle on the producer-selected certificate and on certificate modes a verifier does not implement (Evidence Bundle -02). See README.md.

cases.description: The eight records of the padded log, producer-selected, in the shape producers emit (payloads_mode none, no range): each record's proof checks, the interval is not shown.
The same with the root record's inclusion proof edited.
The producer-selected Bundle with a selection value this document does not define: interval coverage and per-record membership are withheld, never failed.
The producer-selected Bundle with a selection value that is not a string: interval coverage and per-record membership are withheld, never failed.
A valid range certificate [33, 64] under an unknown selection value: the verifier does not read the certificate under a mode it does not implement.
The valid range [33, 64] with selection null: present and not a string, so not a range certificate.
The tampered producer-selected Bundle without checkpoint.cose: the proof is still checked against the stated checkpoint, and fails.
The producer-selected certificate names another log than the checkpoint.
